name: bybit_l2_scalping_research_v1
status: pre-data frozen capture protocol; public-data-only; no live orders
raw_format: jsonl; one JSON object per received websocket message

capture.integrity: Retain every snapshot and delta verbatim. Report reconnects, sequence resets, timestamp reversals, and no-message intervals over 5 seconds.

hypothesis.name: trend_conditioned_pullback
hypothesis.definition: A 5-minute directional regime plus a 1-minute pullback and renewed aggressive trade-flow confirmation.
hypothesis.selection_rule: Do not select numerical thresholds or symbols after examining the holdout. Freeze them from development data only.

execution_assumptions.maker_fill_policy: Queue-aware or zero-fill when queue position cannot be evidenced.
execution_assumptions.emergency_exit: taker, reduce-only, with observed book-walk slippage
execution_assumptions.funding: Charge official funding events at the position notional.

promotion_gates: No silent data gaps in selected sessions
Deterministic replay and fill tests pass
Positive development and untouched-holdout portfolio results after costs
Explicit user approval before any live-trading work
